title: natives is deprecated
summary: npm states that natives relies on Node.js internals and will break, and directs users to graceful-fs 4.x.

constraints: Preserve filesystem behavior, retry semantics, and compatibility with the Node.js versions supported by the project.

steps.title: Replace natives
steps.instructions: Replace the natives dependency and imports with graceful-fs 4.x, using its public filesystem API instead of Node.js internals.

steps.title: Verify filesystem behavior
steps.instructions: Exercise affected file operations, including concurrent access and error paths, on every supported Node.js version.

verification.purpose: Run filesystem behavior and repository tests when defined.
